title: Rebase nested the camera e2e capture/exit block inside `if app.noc_e2e` — PP_CAM_E2E=1 alone captures nothing and never exits
detail: In the base (6b95439) both e2e capture blocks were siblings under one `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false)`; the ungating re-used the gate's braces, so the cam captures + CAM_E2E_EXIT break now sit inside `if app.noc_e2e`. PP_CAM_E2E=1 alone (the camera branch's acceptance drive) injects events but never captures and never exits — contradicting the PR-body rebase-fold claim "both PP_NOC_E2E=1 (D toggle) and PP_CAM_E2E=1 (wheel/pan) are env-gated and live in any build".
recommended_fix: Close `if app.noc_e2e` immediately after the NOC_E2E_EXIT break and restore `if app.cam_e2e` as a sibling at loop depth (the base's structure minus the `when`); re-run PP_CAM_E2E=1 standalone to prove captures + exit.

title: effect_zoom docblock still describes the obsolete PP_DEBUG scroll gate + release fall-through the rebase deleted
detail: The body ten lines below is the ungated scroll with a hard `return` (no gate, no fall-through). The docblock is stale camera-branch r3-B2 prose contradicting the merged semantics this rebase established.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the docblock to the runtime-gated semantics (live panel + live scroll in every build), matching the inline comment already in the Noc_Scroll case.

title: Stale cam-e2e comments still claim PP_DEBUG-only gating after the rebase ungated both e2e arms
detail: Both comments (main.odin:57-58 and :208-209) assert a compile gate the rebase removed from every cam-e2e code path; the drive is env-gated in any build now. Misleading prose on an explicit merge point.
recommended_fix: Drop the "PP_DEBUG" clauses from both comments ("env-gated, any build", matching the noc-e2e comment style).

title: W2 nav pin's comments and failure message still describe the pre-merge 4-Downs/5-row panel
detail: The row merge made it 5 Downs to row 5 with SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT :: 6 (settings_panel.odin). The pin itself still bites (symbolic rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_NOC loop; nav wraps at rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT in exec.odin:62-66) — only the prose/assertion message is stale, so a real failure would print misleading diagnostics.
recommended_fix: Update the comment and expect message to the merged reality (5 Downs, count 6) or reference the constants instead of hardcoded prose numbers.

title: PR body self-contradicts on CI gate 9 (pre-rebase rationale vs the merged richer leg)
evidence:
"- **PP_DEBUG remains only for the harness `overlay-check` verb.** The dev flag survives as a harness-only tool; the app's surface is runtime-gated. CI gate 9 renamed to match ("PP_DEBUG overlay-check verb (harness dev tool)") — the app define build was redundant (gate 3 already proves the normal shape)."
vs the rebase fold:
"- **CI gate 9 merged:** the camera's richer leg won (app + harness PP_DEBUG builds + the PP_DEBUG test leg) — ci.yml and ci-local.sh aligned gate-for-gate."
detail: The stale pre-rebase bullet claims the app define build was dropped; the actual ci.yml/ci-local.sh carry the camera's richer leg named "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile + the debug test leg)" (app+harness builds + `odin test app -define:PP_DEBUG=true`). The body contradicts itself and the code.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the "PP_DEBUG remains only..." bullet's gate-9 sentence to describe the merged gate (the richer leg), or delete the sentence.
